core: Viral genome replication and replicase translation
qualifier: coronavirus
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting, capping, IFIT evasion and host control of viral replication, distinguishing it from confusables built on APOBEC3G/RNA editing restriction or PKR-centred viral mRNA translation.

qualifier: 5-lipoxygenase leukotriene and lipoxin branch
name: 5-lipoxygenase leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, transport and omega-oxidative breakdown of leukotrienes, lipoxins and 5-HETE, unlike confusables centred on cytochrome P450 HETE/EET and 12/15-lipoxygenase products or on leukotriene receptor signalling.

qualifier: CDX-specified absorptive programme
name: CDX-driven differentiated intestinal epithelium identity
rationale: Members describe the CDX/KLF5-specified differentiated intestinal epithelium and its maintenance (with one stray leukocyte migration term), distinguished from HNF4-driven liver-intestine modules, Wnt crypt stem programmes and Paneth-cell antimicrobial defence.

qualifier: ADA and PNP deficiency
name: Purine deoxynucleoside metabolism and ADA/PNP deficiency
rationale: All members concern purine deoxyribonucleosides and dNTPs including ADA and PNP defects, unlike confusables on purine ribonucleotide synthesis and salvage, ribonucleoside catabolism or pyrimidine deoxynucleotides.

qualifier: anticodon-loop modification and RNA pseudouridylation for translational fidelity
name: tRNA modification, RNA pseudouridylation and aminoacylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA anticodon-loop modifications (t6A, wybutosine, wobble), RNA pseudouridylation and methylation, and cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation for fidelity, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end processing, splicing and translation-factor modification.

qualifier: depolarization and gap junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac conduction depolarization and gap junction electrical coupling
rationale: Members concern phase 0 depolarization along AV node, His-Purkinje and ventricular cells plus gap junction coupling, distinguishing them from confusables built on potassium-channel repolarization, SA-node HCN pacemaking or conduction system development.

qualifier: macrophage foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
name: Oxidized LDL response, foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
rationale: Members link oxidized LDL signalling to foam cell differentiation, cholesterol storage and phosphatidylcholine breakdown, unlike confusables about lipoprotein assembly, remodelling, clearance and cholesterol efflux or scavenger receptor families.

qualifier: stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
name: Stalled ribosome rescue and no-go/non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover dissociation of stalled ribosomes on no-go and non-stop mRNAs, RQC nascent-peptide degradation and associated mRNA decay, unlike confusables centred on nonsense-mediated decay, stress granules or degron pathways.

qualifier: endothelial VEGF/shear signalling and vascular smooth muscle phenotype
name: Angiogenesis and vascular endothelial and smooth muscle cell regulation
rationale: Members span sprouting angiogenesis, VEGF/Tie2/shear-stress endothelial signalling and vascular smooth muscle proliferation and phenotypic switching, whereas all confusables are about heart and cardiomyocyte development.

qualifier: filament severing, capping and depolymerization
name: Leading-edge actin turnover by severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: Members concern lamellipodial and pseudopodial actin turnover via severing, barbed-end capping, depolymerization and Arp2/3 inhibition, unlike confusables centred on actin polymerization, ruffling and WAVE/WASP activation.

qualifier: pancreatic endocrine and adrenal neuroendocrine lineages
name: Neuroendocrine cell differentiation, pancreatic endocrine and adrenal
rationale: Members cover NEUROG3+ endocrine progenitors, alpha cell differentiation, adrenal development and endocrine transdifferentiation, distinguished from confusables on endoderm/pancreatic progenitors and sympathetic or neural precursors.

qualifier: NLRP3 and NLRP1
name: NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasome activation and IL-1 processing
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes, purinergic triggering and IL-1 precursor processing, unlike confusables built on CASP4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, pyroptosis, IL-18 or chemokine production.

core: Barrier permeability and mechanical stress response
qualifier: tight junction regulation and PIEZO1 mechanosensing
name: Tight junction barrier permeability and PIEZO1 mechanical stress response
rationale: Members combine tight-junction control of endothelial, intestinal and blood-brain barrier permeability with PIEZO1 shear and pressure sensing, volume and membrane repair responses, unlike confusables on adherens/desmosomal adhesion, eNOS trafficking or lipid scrambling.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA, adiponectin and insulin sensitivity
name: Glucagon, adiponectin and insulin-sensitivity control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate gluconeogenesis, glucose uptake and insulin responsiveness through glucagon-PKA, adiponectin, AMPK and caloric restriction, unlike confusables on glycogen/glucokinase, lipolysis, ChREBP glucose sensing or proximal insulin receptor-GLUT4 signalling.

qualifier: negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis
name: Negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis, VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling
rationale: Members restrain endothelial sprouting, migration, proliferation and VEGF responsiveness via VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling, whereas confusables carry the positive angiogenic regulators, VEGF production or neuropilin/lymphangiogenesis terms.

qualifier: Rap1 and p130Cas/GRB2-SOS linkage to MAPK
name: Rap1 signaling and integrin linkage to MAPK
rationale: Members cover Rap1 signal transduction and p130Cas or GRB2:SOS coupling of integrins to MAPK, unlike confusables on platelet activation GPCRs, RAF mutant signalling or integrin-mediated cell adhesion.

core: T cell activation and antigen receptor signalling
qualifier: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: T cell receptor signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members centre on proximal TCR signalling, CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and T cell activation signatures, distinguished from confusables on BCR signalling, thymic selection, ICOS/germinal centre help or CD27.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensor signalling to type I interferon induction
name: Viral nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, AIM2 and endosomal TLR signalling through TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 to interferon production, unlike confusables centred on downstream IFN receptor responses, ISG15 or TLR7/8 specifics.

qualifier: neural folding and neuron fate determination
name: Neural plate patterning, neural folding and neuron fate determination
rationale: The three members concern neural plate regionalization, neural fold formation and neuron fate determination, while confusables centre on anterior/posterior plate formation, neural crest and hindbrain or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: thymocyte and bone marrow proliferation and apoptosis
name: Thymocyte and bone marrow cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, apoptosis and differentiation of thymocytes and bone marrow cells to set tissue cell numbers, unlike confusables on B cell/progenitor differentiation, kidney development or thymic selection.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, turnover and RISC assembly
name: Small RNA biogenesis, turnover and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA and siRNA processing, miRNA degradation, RISC assembly and silencing by mRNA destabilization or translational repression, unlike confusables on specific miRNA-regulated transcripts or deadenylation-dependent decay.

core: Epithelial cell migration in wound healing
qualifier: growth factor-driven adhesion turnover
name: Growth factor-driven epithelial migration in wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration and wound spreading with EGF/VEGFR2 signalling and junction, focal adhesion and matrix turnover, unlike confusables on wound proliferation and inflammation or Rho/Rac-mediated suppression of spreading.

core: Blood pressure and vascular tone regulation
qualifier: nitric oxide-cGMP and renin-angiotensin
name: Blood pressure control by nitric oxide-cGMP and renin-angiotensin
rationale: Members cover eNOS/BH4-driven NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation and contraction plus renin-angiotensin and endothelin control of arterial pressure, unlike confusables centred on renal filtration/vasopressin or adrenergic receptor signalling.

qualifier: hexose, glycogen and pentose phosphate pathways with inborn errors
name: Hexose, glycogen and pentose phosphate metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members span glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen, galactose, fructose and non-oxidative pentose phosphate metabolism with their inherited enzyme defects, unlike confusables on hexose transport and digestion, glucagon signalling or aminosugar and glycosylation metabolism.

qualifier: naive and memory B cell signatures
name: Naive and memory B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members describe B cell signatures, CD27 signalling and positive regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation and BCR signalling, unlike confusables centred on germinal centre, Tfh and ICOS-driven responses.
